GAS SAFETY

Check the person.
Check the work.

Gas work needs the right registration and qualifications. Verify the engineer and the type of work before arranging an appointment.

Use the official register.

Ask to see a current Gas Safe ID card and check that the engineer is qualified for the appliances and type of gas work involved. You can verify details through the official Gas Safe Register.

For Grandison gas work enquiries, confirm current registration, the scope and availability directly with Connor before booking.

Visit the Gas Safe Register ↗

If you suspect a gas leak or carbon monoxide problem, do not wait for an online enquiry. Follow the official emergency guidance.
